camera: Flat front-facing UI: a modal popup over the dimmed main game screen.

hudLayout.topThird: Dimmed main screen: header with chapter book '1', counters coin '0', star '0', pink meeple '3.71K', 4-segment quest bar with gold '0/4'; wood strip with one quest scroll centred; khaki tab bar with 'LOCAL FARM' (farm icon, red badge '2') and four dark locked tabs; top-down terrain map with an empty hero slot centre.
hudLayout.middleThird: Modal khaki parchment panel from 32% to 68% height, 10-90% width, flat khaki fill with a thin darker lower lip; crimson square 'X' close button at its top-right corner; centred three-line white bold message 'Welcome back! You earned 3.6K followers while you were gone.'; near the bottom a centred amber button 'DOUBLE IT!'. Behind, peeking at the edges: a dimmed dungeon row (locked henchman tile with padlock left; carrot drop tile '29' with red badge '1' and teal 'MAX HIRE' button right).
hudLayout.bottomThird: Below the popup, dark navy dimmed field; walnut wood footer with steel cog right, 'username' centre, 'fps: 0' debug left.

uiStyle: Flat khaki 9-slice popup with a darker lip, crimson soft-slab close button with white X, amber soft-slab CTA with cream bold caps; white bold sans body text with soft dark shadow; everything behind dimmed under a dark scrim.
colorPalette: Warm khaki panel and amber CTA pop against a darkened, desaturated game screen and navy field.
composition: Single centred modal dominates; eye goes to the message then down to the DOUBLE IT! button.
